dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Let's go with some fruit today... Hmm, no. Even in that, we should have variety...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes? What's on the menu today?

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Today it's... Oh, it's you. I thought it was that old fogey. Seriously, what's his problem, shouting all the time at his age? My poor ears...

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Well, anyway. I've prepared some Sunsettia and Berry slices mixed in Sweet Flower juice, along with some minced Berries and Mints...

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: See you. I'll be off to feed the Sumpter Beasts, then.

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: That won't come cheap, you know! The ingredients I use are all fresh as can be.

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: That old fogey's a miser and wouldn't listen to anyone to save his life... But he's generous enough when it comes to the Sumpter Beasts.

dialogues.speaker: Tusheng
dialogues.text: Hmph, not that this would ever lead to me getting a raise, though.
